snippet.title: Paper Detour | 10 Grain Presets + Parallax | 1s Cards | 2K Test v02
snippet.description:
Private technical comparison for user review. The same user-supplied paper watchmaker scene now has identical gentle camera movement and aligned depth parallax from left to right in all ten grain variants. One-second numbered settings card before every four-second moving image. Settings remain visible at the bottom throughout. Exactly50seconds,2560x1440,30fps,BT.709SDR,silent.

01 Balanced Base: luma RMS 3.0 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.77 output pixels, 30Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.65.
02 Soft Amplitude: luma RMS 2.4 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.77 output pixels, 30Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.65.
03 Upper Amplitude: luma RMS 4.0 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.77 output pixels, 30Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.65.
04 Fine Grain: luma RMS 3.0 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.60 output pixels, 30Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.65.
05 Coarse Grain: luma RMS 3.0 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.95 output pixels, 30Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.65.
06 Slow Refresh 15: luma RMS 3.0 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.77 output pixels, 15Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.65.
07 Slow Refresh 10: luma RMS 3.0 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.77 output pixels, 10Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.65.
08 Short Persistence: luma RMS 3.0 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.77 output pixels, 30Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.35.
09 Long Persistence: luma RMS 3.0 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.77 output pixels, 30Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.85.
10 Test 03 Scaled: luma RMS 3.6 codes, Gaussian sigma 0.77 output pixels, 30Hz noise-field updates, rho 0.65.

Same ten grain settings as the previous static comparison. The underlying scene stays30fps even when only the grain field updates at15or10Hz. Grain is applied after movement and is excluded from the labels. Monochrome grain with protected shadows/highlights. RMS means noise contrast, not opacity or amount. Sigma is a filter radius, not measured grain diameter. No universal production preset selected; compare at1440pand1080p.
